title: Gabriel Popescu abelian core
statement:
theorem gabriel_popescu_abelian_core
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    [HasCoproducts.{max w vA vH} (DerivedCategory A)] :
    ∃ (S : Type w) (rS : Ring S),
      letI := rS
      ∃ hD : HasDerivedCategory.{max w vH} (ModuleCat.{max w vH} S),
      letI := hD
      ∃ (F : ModuleCat.{max w vH} S ⥤ A) (U : A ⥤ ModuleCat.{max w vH} S)
        (adj₀ : F ⊣ U) (addF : F.Additive)
        (limF : PreservesFiniteLimits F) (colimF : PreservesFiniteColimits F),
      let _ := addF
      let _ := limF
      let _ := colimF
      IsIso adj₀.counit

source.place: injectives-lemma-gabriel-popescu; Tag 0F5X first paragraph; Tag 05NU for Baer criterion in the size extension

proof.text: Shrink the hom types of A to universe w. Choose its separator G and S=End(G)^op. Construct U explicitly as ShrinkHoms.equivalence.functor followed by preadditiveCoyonedaObj G and ModuleCat.uliftFunctor to modules in Type max(w,vH). Apply the large-Hom adjoint-existence component to this fixed U.

Mathlib GabrielPopescu.full and the separator-faithfulness equivalence show the small Hom functor is fully faithful. ShrinkHoms.equivalence.functor and ModuleCat.uliftFunctor are fully faithful, so U is fully faithful. Mathlib GabrielPopescu.preservesInjectiveObjects and ModuleCat.uliftFunctor preserve injectives (the latter by the Baer criterion for a w-small ring); the equivalence does also. Thus U preserves injectives.

Let F be the left adjoint determined up to natural isomorphism by U.IsRightAdjoint. Enough injectives and preservation of injectives by U imply F preserves monomorphisms. As a left adjoint F preserves finite colimits and binary coproducts, hence binary biproducts and is additive. Preservation of monomorphisms and cokernels gives preservation of homology, hence finite limits. Full faithfulness of U gives the invertible counit. Construct the required derived module category from its Grothendieck structure, transferred from modules over the lifted ring ULift S, and assemble the witnesses.

proof_origin.place: Separate adjoint existence for the fixed lifted Hom functor; discharge full faithfulness, Baer size extension, exactness and counit by Mathlib GabrielPopescu, ModuleCat.Ulift and adjunction APIs.
